# Arrow-key navigation no longer scrolls a grid horizontally

## Context

Found while building Tab traversal for grid cell editing (#18861), which scrolls its target into sight through the same primitive the arrow keys use. Measured on `dev@f44ddcf81e`, fixture `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing`, grid `#grid-cell-editing-pooled` (40 columns of 150px, 1400px viewport), with no editing involved.

## The Problem

Click cell `r3c3`, press ArrowRight twelve times. The selection moves to `c15`; the grid does not scroll: `.neo-grid-horizontal-scrollbar` stays at `scrollLeft: 0`, the selected column leaves the mounted window, and no cell carries `neo-selected` any more. The keyboard walks off-screen. ArrowDown scrolls as it should (`scrollTop` 636 after thirty presses).

## The Architectural Reality

`grid.Container#scrollByColumns` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1340`) ends in `Neo.main.DomAccess.scrollTo({direction: 'left', id: me.getVdomRoot().id, …})` — it scrolls the container's root node. That was the horizontal scroll owner when #8982 / #8999 fixed this path in February. Since the multi-body architecture (#9612) the owner is the `grid.HorizontalScrollbar` the container creates (`:304`); the root no longer scrolls, so the call lands nowhere. `grid.View#scrollByRows` was not affected.

With `id: me.horizontalScrollbar.id`, the same twelve presses give `scrollLeft: 1000` and `r3c15` selected and rendered; thirty ArrowDowns after it keep `r33c15` selected and rendered.

**Measured once the scroll moved again (2026-09-18), two more defects in the same method:** at `scrollLeft: 1000` the selected `r3c15` sits at x 1282–1432, entirely under the locked-end body (1280–1430); the center body shows 182–1280.

- The target is read as `body.columnPositions.getAt(index + step)` with the selection model's index, which counts `columns.items`. `columnPositions` holds the center columns only, so every locked-start column shifts the target by one: the method positioned `c16` for a selection on `c15`.
- It aligns a right-moving target to `body.containerWidth`, the whole container's width, not to what the center body shows — the container less the two locked regions, which `grid.HorizontalScrollbar` carries as `startWidth` / `endWidth`.

## The Fix

`scrollByColumns` resolves the target column in `columns`, skips a locked one (always in sight), reads its position by `dataField`, and scrolls the horizontal scrollbar only when the column lies outside `[scrollLeft, scrollLeft + visible width]`. The stale `visibleColumns` bookkeeping goes: `grid.Body#afterSetScrollLeft` recomputes it on every scroll. One Brain-free e2e spec on the pooled fixture.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Arrowing right past the visible columns scrolls the grid: the selected cell stays rendered and fully inside the center body's visible width; arrowing back left does the same in reverse. Red on `dev` first.
- [ ] The arm runs in the CI e2e tier; no correctness sleeps.
- [ ] The grid e2e and component tiers stay green.

## Out of Scope

`grid.Body#updateMountedAndVisibleColumns` also counts the columns under the locked-end body as visible (it uses the same `containerWidth`) — harmless for mounting, noted · Tab traversal (#18861), which inherits this.

## Related

#8982 · #8999 (the earlier fix of this path) · #9612 (the multi-body change after which the root stopped scrolling) · #18861.
